name: ServiceProviderWfmRowParserV1
row_identity: resolve RFC No. and Task No. by header registry
RFC No. must be exact NC+14 and Task No. exact TK+14; no truncation/fuzzy/suffix stripping
both identities usable -> entity_kind=wfm, canonical_primary_id=Task No., canonical_parent_rfc_no=RFC No., observed_valid_identity
either required identity unusable -> invalid_row with field-specific finding and no WFM/RFC mutation
repeated RFC No. across distinct canonical Task Nos is valid and expected

active_fields.authority: provisional RFC hint only; cannot override accepted Enhanced RFC status

active_fields.blank: valid without missing warning when task_status=Plan Cancel; otherwise explicit blank/coverage finding

plan_validation: planned_start blank and planned_end blank -> valid unscheduled provider source plan
exactly one usable endpoint -> WFM_PLAN_INCOMPLETE row-level error for scheduling facts; identity/other independent valid source fields may still stage at smallest safe scope
both usable require end > start; otherwise WFM_PLAN_INVALID_INTERVAL
accepted instants persist canonical UTC whole seconds and any valid minute/second is accepted; no half-hour rounding/restriction
source plan is immutable provider evidence and never silently becomes accepted operational Task plan or Objective membership
row_chronology: the accepted workbook embedded export timestamp is the WFM source-observation chronology for row/source revisions; planned start/end are business plan facts and do not order workbook observations.
duplicate_partition: group by canonical Task No.; repeated RFC across different Task Nos is never duplicate
same Task No. + same owning RFC + identical allowlisted logical content is equivalent duplicate and may collapse for effective proposal generation with warning
same Task No. with conflicting owning RFC or meaningful field content records all observations and blocks only that Task identity's affected proposal scope
parent RFC correction after WFM history is always high-risk owning-domain review, never silent import reassignment
status_semantics: Complete and Plan Cancel may create/adopt exact WFM identity as historical provider evidence but never create active work, promote/reactivate RFC, accept operational plan or create Objective
unrecognized nonblank Task Status remains warning-bearing source evidence without terminal/active lifecycle authority
active nonterminal WFM acceptance requires owning RFC Implement eligibility from LLD-03 or separately reviewed provisional eligibility for a bootstrapped missing RFC
proposal_seeds: missing RFC exact identity -> provisional RFC creation seed under LLD-03 plus optional reviewed provisional eligibility seed only when applicable active WFM evidence supports it
existing RFC -> WFM create/adopt/source-projection seed under LLD-05
material source-plan difference -> plan reconciliation seed under LLD-05; source acceptance and operational-plan acceptance remain separate
Task Name -> SR-link candidate extraction only when owning RFC Summary yields no candidate under accepted precedence
Customer Organization -> reviewed Customer candidate only
activity-lineage/overlap evidence -> competing-attempt review seed; import never invents retry lineage
prohibitions: no provider status overwrite from absence
